tests: <sl-menu-item> > should pass accessibility tests when using a submenu
<sl-menu-item> > should have the correct default properties
<sl-menu-item> > should render the correct aria attributes when disabled
<sl-menu-item> > should return a text label when calling getTextLabel()
<sl-menu-item> > should emit the slotchange event when the label changes
<sl-menu-item> > should render a hidden menu item when the inert attribute is used
<sl-menu-item> > should not render a sl-popup if the slot="submenu" attribute is missing, but the slot should exist in the component and be hidden.
<sl-menu-item> > should render an sl-popup if the slot="submenu" attribute is present
<sl-menu-item> > should focus on first menuitem of submenu if ArrowRight is pressed on parent menuitem
<sl-menu-item> > should focus on outer menu if ArrowRight is pressed on nested menuitem
<sl-menu-item> > when loading > should have a spinner present
